description: lsp.problems.query filters, orders, and groups Problems tool-window diagnostics and lays the tree rows out. Responses return indices into the submitted diagnostics.

cases.name: default groups files in natural path order and sorts by severity inside each file
severity groups list errors first and unknown severities last
position order ranks line and column before file and keeps submission order for ties
severity filter keeps totals for the unfiltered list
unknown severity is selected with zero
file scope and source filter compare the source case-insensitively
query trims and matches the one-based line and column label
query matches the display path case-insensitively
a closed file node hides its diagnostics and takes their selection
the selection follows a diagnostic the server republished at another index
a gone diagnostic selects its file node when the list is grouped by file
a gone diagnostic selects nothing when the list is grouped by severity
severity nodes close by key and keep a node selection
the ungrouped list ignores closed keys and selects only its diagnostics
no visible diagnostics produce no groups
